# Roshan Kc

> Official personal site of Roshan Kc — Cofounder & CTO of MarginTop Solutions, Kathmandu, Nepal.

## Summary

Roshan Kc is a Nepali technology founder, system architect, engineer, and investor. He cofounded MarginTop Solutions and serves as its CTO, leading a growing engineering team building scalable digital ecosystems. He is based in Kathmandu, with the company office in Pulchwok.

- Interests: video editing, graphic design, frontend; swimming, running, cycling

## Company story

MarginTop Solutions began after Roshan finished his bachelor's degree. While teaching higher secondary students (100% pass rate), he took on client projects with cofounder Bibek. They registered an IT company, operated online for six months, and partnered with Sameer. Roshan left teaching to work full-time on the company. After more than a year of struggle, they opened an office in Pulchwok and grew into a thriving Kathmandu engineering team.
